briefHtml:
NAV S$10,143,598 - reported -0.97%, real approx +0.02% after restatement

  • Biggest mover: silver -5.1% to ~$45.05; gold -3.5% to $3,730 (14-month low) - silver line now ~1.84x, equity approx S$47,000
  • The one thing: the NVDA beat wasn't enough - NVDA faded -3.1% and SPX broke its 200-day; the AI trade's problem is now rates, not earnings (hawkish FOMC minutes, Waller 50bp talk, Dec hike 95.7% priced). Anthropic priced at $83 (above range), debuts today. Trump-Xi bilateral plus first trilateral with Putin today in Shenzhen.

Markets

  • US Wed: SPX 7,323.63 -0.23% (5th straight loss, below 200-day); Dow 50,198.17 -1.11%; Nasdaq 24,430 +0.42%; NVDA -3.09%; 10y 5.07%; WTI $82.85; BTC $62,300
  • Asia Wed: HSI 23,294.75 -0.91% (Tencent ~-0.5% pre-print); STI 5,054.89 -1.06% (5th straight, lowest since June 12; DBS -1.6%)
  • Metals: gold futures $3,730 -3.5% (14-month low); silver spot ~$45.05 -5.1%; ratio ~81.6
  • FX: USDSGD 1.2894, USDCNY ~6.66

Flags

  • 10 flags, two new (DBS -5.7% - real move was -1.6%; MYR +1.01% FX). Miner flags inflating again (GDX -12.2%, SILJ -14.2%, SLVP -15.0%) - all stale-baseline artefacts; silver flags finally directionally right (silver -5.1%)
  • L46.SI Yahoo 404 - 36th session

Insider trades

  • None found (SGX API 404 for the 7th straight trading day; Wing Tai pause 9 sessions; US holdings are ETFs)

Congress trades

  • No new filings dated 11/18; window remains 11/16-11/17: FL-19 8-trade batch (buys IBKR; sells NFLX, ZTS, ADSK), CA-50 ($500k-1M T-Bill sale), IL-1 (DDOG, EL buys; BP, SPHR sells), AR-2 (JBGS sale), WA-1 muni switches
  • Source: Unusual Whales

Trump / policy

  • Summit day: Trump-Xi bilateral plus first Trump-Xi-Putin trilateral in Shenzhen; Busan truce extension the working goal; chip curbs not negotiated NPR
  • FOMC minutes hawkish; Waller floats a 50bp December 'shock'; Dec hike ~95.7% priced Investopedia
  • Anthropic priced at $83 (above range), ~$1.5tn, debuts today as ANT
  • NVDA -3.1% despite the beat; SPX below 200-day
  • Trump: US rare-earth output to catch China 'in 10 months' AzerNews
  • Tencent Q3: revenue miss, capex +225%, FCF -RMB69.1bn, net debt RMB13.7bn Quartz

Risk

  • Silver line ~1.84x (equity approx S$47,000, -9.6% on Wednesday alone) - most acute point in the book
  • Metals liquidation: gold 14-month low; miners -6%; but 6th straight physical deficit projected
  • Tape: SPX below 200-day, 5 straight losses; NVDA -32% from October record
  • Tencent miss lands in HK today; FX ~35% non-SGD at 1.2894; STI -6.6% on the month

Alpha (signals, not advice)

  • Real assets: unlevered only; first tranche on gold holding $3,700-3,730 for 2-3 sessions; silver line gets nothing
  • AI bottlenecks: trigger fired Tuesday; deploy in stages - let ANT's debut and NVDA's $150-155 zone prove a floor first
  • Defense: 10y 5.07%, gate 5.20% 13bp away - deploy AT the gate only

trumpWatch.title: Summit day: Trump-Xi bilateral plus first trilateral with Putin
trumpWatch.detail: Shenzhen, Thursday. Bilateral plus working lunch, then the first Trump-Xi-Putin trilateral (denuclearization pitch; no concrete deal expected; Ukraine off the table). Working goal: extend the Busan truce past Jan 10; China pre-extended its rare-earth pause. Chip curbs not negotiated.

trumpWatch.title: Fed hawkishness drives the tape
trumpWatch.detail: October FOMC minutes signaled more hikes; Waller told CNBC the Fed may need to 'shock people' - an explicit 50bp December float. December hike ~95.7% priced, debate on size.

trumpWatch.title: Anthropic priced at $83, above range
trumpWatch.detail: About $1.5tn valuation, at least $68bn raised; roughly $400bn institutional plus $100bn retail indications; NVDA, Google, Microsoft in the $26bn concurrent placement. ANT debuts Thursday on Nasdaq.

trumpWatch.title: NVDA faded the beat
trumpWatch.detail: Stock -3.1% Wednesday, fifth straight loss, despite $115.8bn revenue, ~$130bn Q4 guide and a $2.5tn backlog; market prices rates and the Huang overhang over earnings.

trumpWatch.title: Trump claims US rare-earth output catches China in 10 months
trumpWatch.detail: Pre-APEC remark to reporters; a theme talking point, not a verified supply figure.

trumpWatch.title: Tencent Q3 miss: AI capex pivot costs
trumpWatch.detail: Revenue RMB207.3bn +8%, below RMB210.8bn consensus; non-IFRS operating profit -6%; capex payments +225% to RMB65.1bn; FCF -RMB69.1bn; net debt RMB13.7bn vs net cash RMB102.4bn a year ago; cloud +35%. HK reacts Thursday.

opportunities.thesis: Real assets (target 20%): gold $3,730 (14-month low), silver $45.05 (-61.8% from 52-wk high) with a sixth consecutive annual physical deficit projected - most extreme paper-vs-physical divergence of the cycle.
opportunities.signal: Unlevered sleeve only: first tranche triggers on gold holding $3,700-3,730 for 2-3 sessions; the leveraged line at ~1.84x gets nothing - survival first

opportunities.thesis: AI bottlenecks (target 15%, 0% deployed): Tuesday's beat-and-raise fired the deployment trigger, but NVDA faded -3.1% and SPX broke its 200-day. Anthropic's $83 pricing (~$500bn orders, above range) confirms private AI demand; public-market rates set the entry.
opportunities.signal: Deploy in stages from the ~62% idle cash; let ANT's debut and NVDA's $150-155 zone prove a floor before the first full tranche

opportunities.thesis: Defense (target 15%): 10y at 5.07%, gate 5.20% now 13bp away; hawkish minutes plus Waller's 50bp float make the gate more reachable into the Dec 9 FOMC.
opportunities.signal: Deploy AT the gate only, in size, nowhere else
